accepted: The cached matched frame reduces the clipped wet-raft highlight band while retaining more tube microtexture.
Bilateral local exposure improves shadowed face, PFD and wetsuit readability without editing scene lights or material response.

Local exposure cannot replace production material, lighting, character, animation or environment art.
